name: human-todo
description: Sidebar of the action items Claude hands to you in this session: upcoming, current, done. Resolve them in place and Claude is told.

shortcut.title: Sidebar shortcut
shortcut.description: Chord that toggles the sidebar; written to ~/.claude/keybindings.json on load. Same on Windows and macOS.

wakeClaude.title: Wake Claude on resolve
wakeClaude.description: When on, resolving a todo starts a turn so Claude reacts right away. Off: Claude reads it with its next request.
